description: One bit of the dataset file is flipped.
A fraction of cells is shifted by +0.3 standard deviations, staying inside physical limits.
A fraction of cells is multiplied by 10 (a decimal-shift edit).
A fraction of rows gets four columns pushed to +/-4 robust standard deviations.
A temperature column is converted from Celsius to Fahrenheit.
A fraction of a binary factor label is flipped.
The weights of a trained model are perturbed and the model re-verified.
One ledger block payload is edited on a temporary copy of the ledger.
